mandatory_rules: Original NASA documents and datasets retain their publisher terms and are never automatically relicensed under Apache-2.0.
Every transformed record must retain source_url, dataset_id, version, original measurement units, and is_live_telemetry=false.
Controlled human raw files requiring OSDR Data Access Request (DAR) / IRB approval must never be fetched, stored, or fabricated.
Missing or unimported archives (such as CliFF 119 PDFs) must remain explicitly flagged NOT_IMPORTED / UNVERIFIED.

datasets.license_or_terms: CC0-1.0 (open metadata/transformed tables); controlled raw human files subject to OSDR DAR / IRB Protocol 21-05023569
allowed_reuse: Cite DOI and study version v3 in NASA Explore reference panels
Display open summary metadata and pre/post-flight mission-relative timepoint labels (L-92 to R+194)
prohibited_reuse: Redistributing controlled raw human files without DAR/IRB authorization
Presenting Inspiration4 ground draws as live in-flight crew telemetry or clinical thresholds

operations: Extract study metadata, assay types, and declared units (NPQ, pg/mL, Quest CMP units, day, degC) without altering numerical scales.
Attach provenance fields: source_id='OSD-575', version='3', is_live_telemetry=false, verification_state='VERIFIED_METADATA_FROM_OSDR'.

allowed_reuse: Reference processed summary metadata and hazard-domain mapping with attribution
prohibited_reuse: Downloading or redistributing controlled human genomic sequences without DAR/IRB

operations: Map study metadata and declared units without fabricating individual-level human measurements.
Attach provenance fields: source_id='OSD-569', version='4', is_live_telemetry=false.
